spi_batch_timing.note: Fields describe previous physical batch. Dedup by epoch/sequence//2; only batches containing target native RF/status are covered. Phase/mix are host observations, not causal attribution.

raw_chunk_ack_latency.note: Complete-frame socket read time versus entry to decoder event handling; correlated CHUNK ids/session, normal receiver validation unchanged

wire_metrics.phase_caveat: Host observation boundaries, not MCU event timestamps. Sampled queue is a lower bound; cumulative peak remains acceptance gate. Send counters refer to previous node. Retune is not visible on this wire.
wire_metrics.note: MCU queue/slack/send counters; send weighted once per complete node start. Cumulative MCU peak includes startup.
